Memory has the answer (scope `project:game`, 2026-09-26). Everything below comes from stored traces; no repository was checked out, so I couldn't check it against code.

- **Plan** (node `missing-continuation-slot06-91237eb60b`): first `recovery/admission-discovery-v2/**`, then `recovery/geometry-binding-v2/**` and `runtime-v2` in parallel, then the root consumer (`verify.mjs` + `entry-result.json`). v1 geometry verify is blocked only because it calls v1 `verifyAdmission`. v1 `assembly/reconstruct.mjs` is protected, so the consumer has to inline its own assembly.
- **admission-discovery-v2 (done):** commit `9bbc0624`, producer `d081d7b7`, parent `19d41c0b`. It exports `{ measure, verify, verifyProducer, liveRegistry, OWN, CATALOG, CATALOG_BLOB }` from `recovery/admission-discovery-v2/verify.mjs`. Selected family is `rock-jungle-a` (rank 6); it is not registered (`selectedFamilyMember=false`). Live catalog has 4 families and matches the accepted-base blob `78384bf9`. `verify()` takes about 16s.
- **Pitfall:** the producer proof binds the `verify.mjs` bytes. Any repair to `verify.mjs` after produce breaks the proof and needs a new version.
- **geometry-binding-v2 (done):** commits `7c7be4af` (verify*.mjs) and `e6c47257` (docs/proof), raw producer `16d47eda`. It exports `{ measure, verify, verifyProducer, OWN }`. Schema `slot06-geometry-binding-v2` has these keys: `v1GeometryMeasurement` (producer `e4e07c99`), `admissionDiscoveryV2` (sha `000918ea…`, producer `d081d7b7`), `v1AdmissionMeasurementSha256` `ac87f21e…`, `selected`, `sourceProof`, `gateResults`. In `gateResults`, `closed-welded-topology-and-contact` fails.
- **Key trick:** admission-v2 `discovery.selected` is only a projection (no nearBytes/biome/featureVector). The full selection is taken from the stored v1 admission `measurement.json`, after checking projection equality and `discoveryCanonicalSha256`. `verify()` takes about 28s.
